.²4 Admission, acknowledgment.
.²5 Assertion, statement.
.²6 Undertaking, beginning, commencement.
.²7 Action, proceeding, course of action, procedure; {#vayasya kA pratipattiratra#}
 <ls>M. 4</ls>; <ls>Ku. 5. 42</ls>; {#vizAdaluptapratipattivismitaM sEnyam#} <ls>R. 3. 40</ls> ‘which

.²9 Resolution, determination; {#kEkeyyAH pratipattirhi kaTaM syAnmama#}
 {#vedane#} <ls>Rām. 2. 22. 16</ls>; {#vyavasAyaH pratipattinizWuraH#} <ls>R. 8. 65</ls>.
.²10 News, intelligence; {#karmasidDAvASu pratipattimAnaya#} <ls>Mu. 4</ls>; <ls>Ś. 6</ls>.

 {#yatsa mahAnuBAvo vANmAtreRApi akftapratipattiH adakziReti mAM saMBAvayizyati#} <ls>Nāg. 2</ls>.
.²12 A method, means.
.²13 Intellect, intelligence.
.²14 Use, application.
.²15 Promotion, preferment, exaltation.
.²16 Fame, renown, reputation.
.²17 Boldness, assurance, confidence.
.²18 Conviction, proof.
.²19 A rite from which no advantage accrues.
.²20 The concluding portion of an action. (In <ls>Daṇḍaviveka, G. O. S. 52, p. 259</ls>,

.²21 Disposing of a matter or a thing which has served the purpose of something

 <ls>ŚB. on MS. 4. 2. 10</ls>.
